statusDetail: Audit stopped during recon as required because CloudFront returned a 403 "Request blocked" page to both raw-CDP Chrome attempts at https://www.jw.org/ and https://www.jw.org/en/; the requested site UI was never rendered. Direct HTTP fetches could reach public HTML and robots/sitemap, but those are not substitutes for the browser, interaction, visual, accessibility, performance, and memory evidence required to judge the registered checks.

page.notes: The target application did not render in the audit browser. Only a CloudFront-generated 403 document was observable.
